sections.content: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Computational Biology Engineer position at TechCorp GmbH, as advertised under reference TC-BIO-2026-042. With a background in biotechnology and bioinformatics, I am eager to contribute to your team's mission of advancing computational approaches in the life sciences.

content: During my Master's studies in Bioinformatics at Saarland University, I developed end-to-end computational pipelines for multi-omics data integration, including metagenomics, transcriptomics, and proteomics workflows. These pipelines leveraged tools such as QIIME2, DESeq2, and custom Python scripts for automated quality control and statistical analysis.

Prior to my current studies, I gained hands-on experience as a full-stack developer, building web applications and backend services using Python, Node.js, and React. This combination of software engineering and bioinformatics expertise positions me well for a role that bridges computational methods and biological research.

sections.content: My technical skill set includes proficiency in Python, R, and Bash scripting, as well as experience with containerization (Docker), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), and cloud-based data processing. I am comfortable working with both SQL and NoSQL databases and have practical experience deploying reproducible analysis environments.

I am excited about the opportunity to bring my interdisciplinary background to TechCorp GmbH and would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and experience align with your team's goals. I am available for an interview at your earliest convenience.
